metadata.cert_depth_semantics: maximum exact-leaf resolution ply in the verified certificate, minus root placements; it is a sufficient deadline, not a claim of minimal winning depth
metadata.cohort_count_note: cohort membership counts may overlap; grinds are a self-play subset and some IDs occur in multiple frozen cohorts
metadata.eligibility_definition: cert_depth is non-null and cert_depth <= horizon
metadata.id_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array, lexicographically sorted IDs, ensure_ascii=false
metadata.purpose: exact known-WIN validation ladder for Horizon R4
